intake.notes:
Business Pain / Request Notes
Parkway Contractor Supply serves electrical contractors across multiple branches. Reps need faster visibility into breaker, panel, conduit, fittings, and replacement-part availability while customers are at the counter or waiting on job-site fulfillment. Current proof should show branch availability, substitute options, and replenishment timing without forcing the demo into generic inventory language.

Requested Proof
Show a NetSuite proof path for contractor-counter electrical supply: customer context, branch inventory availability, breaker/panel SKU readiness, substitute fulfillment support, and replenishment visibility.

Decision Criteria
The demo must use electrical distributor language, not generic product labels. Returned proof records should include prospect-specific names such as Parkway breaker availability, Parkway branch replenishment, or Parkway safe substitute fulfillment support. Open links must land on real NetSuite records.

Timeline / Urgency
Need an internal proof review before the next contractor-service process meeting.

Competitor / Current Tools
Branch spreadsheets, counter rep tribal knowledge, disconnected inventory reports, and manual substitute lookup.

COV / Call Notes
Customer cares most about contractor trust at the counter. If a breaker or panel is not available at the preferred branch, reps need to quickly see nearby availability, replenishment timing, and safe substitute options. The value story should focus on fewer missed jobs, faster counter response, and cleaner branch-to-branch fulfillment decisions.

Optional Website / Category Evidence
Electrical supply distributor. Relevant categories include breakers, panels, conduit, fittings, wire, disconnects, safety stock, replacement parts, branch inventory, and contractor counter service.

customer.notes:
Business Pain / Request Notes
Parkway Contractor Supply serves electrical contractors across multiple branches. Reps need faster visibility into breaker, panel, conduit, fittings, and replacement-part availability while customers are at the counter or waiting on job-site fulfillment. Current proof should show branch availability, substitute options, and replenishment timing without forcing the demo into generic inventory language.

Requested Proof
Show a NetSuite proof path for contractor-counter electrical supply: customer context, branch inventory availability, breaker/panel SKU readiness, substitute fulfillment support, and replenishment visibility.

Decision Criteria
The demo must use electrical distributor language, not generic product labels. Returned proof records should include prospect-specific names such as Parkway breaker availability, Parkway branch replenishment, or Parkway safe substitute fulfillment support. Open links must land on real NetSuite records.

Timeline / Urgency
Need an internal proof review before the next contractor-service process meeting.

Competitor / Current Tools
Branch spreadsheets, counter rep tribal knowledge, disconnected inventory reports, and manual substitute lookup.

COV / Call Notes
Customer cares most about contractor trust at the counter. If a breaker or panel is not available at the preferred branch, reps need to quickly see nearby availability, replenishment timing, and safe substitute options. The value story should focus on fewer missed jobs, faster counter response, and cleaner branch-to-branch fulfillment decisions.

Optional Website / Category Evidence
Electrical supply distributor. Relevant categories include breakers, panels, conduit, fittings, wire, disconnects, safety stock, replacement parts, branch inventory, and contractor counter service.

customer.notes:
Business Pain / Request Notes
Parkway Contractor Supply serves electrical contractors across multiple branches. Reps need faster visibility into breaker, panel, conduit, fittings, and replacement-part availability while customers are at the counter or waiting on job-site fulfillment. Current proof should show branch availability, substitute options, and replenishment timing without forcing the demo into generic inventory language.

Requested Proof
Show a NetSuite proof path for contractor-counter electrical supply: customer context, branch inventory availability, breaker/panel SKU readiness, substitute fulfillment support, and replenishment visibility.

Decision Criteria
The demo must use electrical distributor language, not generic product labels. Returned proof records should include prospect-specific names such as Parkway breaker availability, Parkway branch replenishment, or Parkway safe substitute fulfillment support. Open links must land on real NetSuite records.

Timeline / Urgency
Need an internal proof review before the next contractor-service process meeting.

Competitor / Current Tools
Branch spreadsheets, counter rep tribal knowledge, disconnected inventory reports, and manual substitute lookup.

COV / Call Notes
Customer cares most about contractor trust at the counter. If a breaker or panel is not available at the preferred branch, reps need to quickly see nearby availability, replenishment timing, and safe substitute options. The value story should focus on fewer missed jobs, faster counter response, and cleaner branch-to-branch fulfillment decisions.

Optional Website / Category Evidence
Electrical supply distributor. Relevant categories include breakers, panels, conduit, fittings, wire, disconnects, safety stock, replacement parts, branch inventory, and contractor counter service.
